rules.values: Only private route paths, independent route headers, the project-identity digest, and source identity remain in Catalyst Development configuration. The contained controller has no token, form URL, CRM, Connection, Data Store, outbound-network, or session variable.
rules.logging: No runtime variable or request payload may be logged.
rules.development: Both assisted routes validate method, JSON content headers, route, and authentication, then return configuration_invalid before reading the request body or initializing the Catalyst SDK, Data Store adapter, CRM Connection, token/session machinery, or outbound-network I/O.
rules.production: The committed source accepts only dependency-free dark Production and rejects Production activation or an unstamped artifact.
